
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("Vs30.docx", inherits = FALSE)) Vs30.docx <- 800
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "PGA caption"
)
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "PGA.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units)) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
root <- here::here()

if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx") || knitr::is_html_output()) {
  Vs30.table <- if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) Vs30.docx else Vs30.gmdp
  P_COLS <- c("0.50", "mean", "0.84", "0.90", "0.95")
  ITo <- unique(AEPTable$ITo)[1]
  DT <- UHSTable[
    .matchP(p, P_COLS) & ID %in% ID.target &
      Vs30 %in% Vs30.table & TR %in% TR.target & siteID == SiteID.caption
  ]
  DT <- DT[, .SD[Tn == min(Tn), .(TR, p, PGA = SaF)], by = Vs30]
  if (PSA_Units %in% c("cm", "cm/s2", "cm/s**2", "cm/s^2")) DT[, PGA := round(PGA * 980.665, 0)]
  if (PSA_Units %in% c("g")) DT[, PGA := round(PGA, 3)]
  DT <- DT[, .(PGA = max(PGA, na.rm = FALSE)), by = .(Vs30, TR, p)]
  PGATable <- dcast(DT, Vs30 + TR ~ p, value.var = "PGA", fun.aggregate = mean)
  P_PRESENT <- intersect(P_COLS, names(PGATable))
  POE <- 100 * (1 - exp(-ITo / as.numeric(PGATable$TR)))
  PGATable[, PoE := fifelse(POE > 0 & POE < 0.1, "<0.1", .formatNumber(POE, 1))]
  PGATable[, TR := as.character(TR)]

  MCE <- MCETable[
    ID == "MCE" & .matchP(p, P_PRESENT) &
      Vs30 %in% Vs30.table & siteID == SiteID.caption
  ]
  if (!nrow(MCE)) stop("PGA.qmd: no MCE rows for the selected site/Vs30.", call. = FALSE)
  MCE <- MCE[Tn == min(Tn), .(Vs30, p, SaF)]
  for (P in P_PRESENT) MCE[.matchP(p, P), p := P]
  if (anyDuplicated(MCE, by = c("Vs30", "p")) ||
      nrow(MCE) != length(P_PRESENT) * length(Vs30.table) ||
      !setequal(MCE$Vs30, Vs30.table) || any(!is.finite(MCE$SaF))) {
    stop("PGA.qmd: expected one finite MCE value per selected Vs30 for each statistic (",
         paste(P_PRESENT, collapse = ", "), ").", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (PSA_Units %in% c("cm", "cm/s2", "cm/s**2", "cm/s^2")) MCE[, SaF := round(SaF * 980.665, 0)]
  if (PSA_Units %in% c("g")) MCE[, SaF := round(SaF, 3)]
  MCE <- dcast(MCE, Vs30 ~ p, value.var = "SaF")
  MCE[, TR := "MCE"]
  MCE[, PoE := "\u2014"]
  PGATable <- rbindlist(list(PGATable, MCE), use.names = TRUE, fill = FALSE)
  setcolorder(PGATable, c("Vs30", "TR", "PoE", P_PRESENT))
  rm(DT, MCE, P, P_COLS, P_PRESENT, POE, ITo, Vs30.table)
}
```
